name: indx_carve
description: Recover file names a directory no longer lists. Parses INDX blocks ($INDEX_ALLOCATION, the $I30 stream) and carves the slack past the end of the live entries, where stale $FILE_NAME structures survive; also sweeps a raw blob for INDX blocks. A slack entry is stale index material: its times are the historical metadata of that structure, not the file's current times and not evidence that they were left unaltered, a name that parses is structurally plausible and not verified, and it does not say the file was deleted. Integrity travels with every entry: block_offset, fixup_ok (every 512-byte unit carries its update sequence number and the array covers the block), node_ok (the node header and each live entry's length, alignment and key length fit the live region) and salvaged. A salvaged block's entries are left out unless include_unreliable is true, and the answer counts the blocks and entries it left out (status partial when any block was salvaged). A live entry that is walked but cannot be read as a name (no key, a name longer than its own key, a bad name length or namespace) is never dropped silently: it is a problem of the run with its MFT reference and the reason, counted in live_entries_unreadable (status partial). A live entry whose values are odd (a parent that is not a believable directory, created and modified times both 0 or all ones) is returned, flagged unreliable with unreliable_reasons and counted in live_entries_flagged_unreliable; the plausibility rules that filter a search of slack are not applied to the entries the directory lists. FILETIMEs are given as ISO 8601 UTC with seven fractional digits and as raw decimal strings.

path.description: An extracted $I30 / $INDEX_ALLOCATION stream, or a raw blob to sweep

slack_only.description: Return only entries carved from slack: the ones the directory no longer lists

name.description: Case-insensitive regex over the recovered names

limit.description: Entries shown inline (default 500, an inline page size); every block is read, and when more entries match the whole list is written as JSON Lines and named in all_results

include_unreliable.description: Include the entries of blocks that failed an integrity check, marked salvaged (default false: they are left out and counted)
